acceptance.interpretation: The measured run passes sustained 60 Hz physics throughput. Headless callback p95 is retained as diagnostic host-scheduling jitter, not treated as rendered-frame evidence.

limitations: One deterministic native headless workload measures physics-frame delivery, not rendered GPU presentation.
Headless fixed ticks may be coalesced by host scheduling, so p95 callback interval is diagnostic while sustained average throughput is the gate.
Godot Compatibility used the full-image upload fallback; the ten-hertz batched cadence is the measured guardrail.
The post-restart object bound is a compact leak sentinel, not a multi-hour soak test.

physics_frame_intervals_ms.engine_monitor_note: TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS is a periodically refreshed aggregate and is not used as a per-tick gate.
